div.span:
Semantic Resolver
Uses fuzzy matching to understand what the player is asking about.
In our example, 'Edmund' is going to match and the resolver will find the appropriate character file to pull in.
Cuts down to only information relevant to the request.
Assesses player attitudes, tone of request etc.

div.span:
At every step, knowledge is filtered out according to gates BEFORE it ever gets included.
Gates are conditions on pieces of knowledge defined by the Pack creator.
Gates can use variables, facts, flags, tracks.

p.span: A briefing is everything the LLM needs to know to build a good response. It is built from the Pack and carefully curated to avoid adding any secrets or irrelevant information.
